verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm AnythingLLM works with external API-backed models: it is used "locally and via APIs", was run with GPT-4o, and the dev says external LLM usage is opt-in per component. Model swapping is also advertised, so the bring-your-own-key half of the story is covered, though thinly. Nothing in the pack shows token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation. missing for 10: token usage visibility, cost tracking per model or conversation, first-party docs on configuring provider API keys or subscriptions.
